definitions.explanation: Three occurrences of something. Used as a counter for the number of times an action occurs.
A measurement of three degrees, used for temperature or angles.

examples.japanese: {三度|さんど}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{三度|さんど}⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I've already watched this movie three times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{三度|さんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}かさない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make sure not to miss three meals a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三度|さんど}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The temperature dropped to three degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{三度|さんど}⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: It's three degrees higher than yesterday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三度|さんど}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please raise the water temperature by just three degrees.

notes:
USAGE:
{三度|さんど} is a straightforward compound of ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ (three) and ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (times/degrees). The reading さんど is standard; the native Japanese alternative {三度|みたび} is literary and means "three times" or "for the third time."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {三度|さんど}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧ — "third time's the charm" (literally: the honesty of the third time)
- ⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{三度|さんど} — even a Buddha's patience has limits (after being taken advantage of three times)
